name: Pika
label: Pika
description: Official Pika customer API at https://api.dev.pika.art. generate_video submits POST /v1/media/{vendor}/{model}/{function} and returns a job id. Poll get_job then get_content. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key as header X-API-Key. Image/video inputs use type file (or HTTPS URL after /v1/media/uploads). Docs: https://pika.art/api · catalog GET https://api.dev.pika.art/catalog/apis. Terms: https://dev.pika.art/terms-of-service. Never log api_key. Verify api_id in the live catalog before submit.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: generate_video: vendor, model, function (path) plus JSON body from the catalog input_schema (prompt, image URL, etc.). get_job / get_content: request_id. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"vendor":"pika","model":"pika-2.5","function":"text-to-video","prompt":"a golden retriever running"}.

schema.label: prompt
schema.description: Text prompt when the selected catalog operation requires it. Confirm required fields via GET /catalog/apis/{api_id}?expand=inputs.

schema.label: image
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for image-to-video ops. Prefer upload via POST /v1/media/uploads then pass the hosted url string. Never inline bytes over the size cap (20MB image).

schema.label: video
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for video-to-video ops. Max 50MB via Pika uploads. Type file.

schema.label: request_id
schema.description: Job id from generate_video for get_job / get_content. Poll until status completed or failed. Do not call get_content before completed.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (job id/status or {url}). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx (job may still be queued).

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (id, status, or content url).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: EXACT: generate_video | get_job | get_content. Default generate_video = POST /v1/media/{vendor}/{model}/{function}.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Pika API key (PIKA_API_KEY). Sent as X-API-Key. StudioQuack secret. Never logged. Dashboard: https://dev.pika.art

configurationParameters.label: Vendor
configurationParameters.description: Path {vendor}. Default pika for first-party models. Live ids from GET /catalog/apis (also hosts other vendors on this same API).

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Path {model}. Default pika-2.5. Confirm the triple vendor/model/function is active in the catalog before paying.

configurationParameters.label: Function
configurationParameters.description: Path {function}. Default text-to-video. Other first-party examples: image-to-video, video-to-video.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-HTTP-call timeout. Default 60. Floor 1. Poll get_job separately; do not wait for the video in generate_video.
